body: #4128 round-2 review at 03a62c1: CHANGES REQUESTED (00:57). The reviewer says the ratchet delta has no correctness defects; all six P2s are completion and coverage claims that predate base f5dab5c. BUG-2531 is still incomplete (wants Refs-only). BUG-2579, BUG-2583, STORY-2775, STORY-2771 and TASK-3448 are already-completed inherited specs with untraced criteria (remove them from claims, or add tests). Cause: integration history is not an ancestor of main, so each promotion's commit range re-lists old trailers. Proposed fix, awaiting the advisor's ruling: add an 'aida: no-complete' line to #4128's body (the BUG-1919 marker) so the promotion completes nothing, complete TASK-3797 by hand after landing, and re-review with the scope 'claims only'. No code change and no new head. Later promotions carry the same line. (product copy)
